::: {.title}
The International Fossil Coral and Reef Society
:::

::: {.lead}
> The Society promotes and shares research on fossil corals, sponges, and reefs, and has done so for over fifty years.
:::

The International Fossil Coral and Reef Society (IFCRS) was founded in the early 1970s under the name '**The International Association for the Study of Fossil Cnidaria and Sponges**'. 

We host an international symposium every four years and an annual online Early Career Researcher symposium. 

We are an all-volunteer society and free to join. We have a long history of being welcoming, supportive, and friendly, and many of our members have made lifelong friends and colleagues through the Society.

[Join the Society](about/membership/index.qmd){.brand-button} [Attend our Events](meetings/ifcrs/index.qmd){.brand-button} [Latest News](#latest-news){.brand-button}
